Luck test (10,000 paired resamples): dropping #22 raises PF in 100% of runs, full period and 2020–23.

Swapping #22 for 017s Smart Money Bot 1h is rejected: max DD $10.0k → $12.1k, 95k pass 93.0%, fresh pass 99.5% (2 of 402 starts fail). 017s is the member most correlated with the rest of the book (0.33).
Swapping #03 Smart Money Bot for 017s failed the luck test (PF better in only 84.4% of 2020–23 runs) and drops 95k pass to 91.8%.

None of the 21 members added in later waves is a bigger drag. Weakest public-script adds: #304 (PF 1.23) and #S1479 (PF 1.24); removing either changes almost nothing. The 19 in-house heads + BTC block are all PF ≥ 1.3.
Warning: 8 of 9 in-house reclaim heads have lower PF in 2024–26 than 2020–23; several Wave138 adds look weak in 2020–23 and strong in 2024–26 (picked with 2024+ in view).
